text.p: HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - The Finance Ministry has criticised the National Bank of Slovakia for failing to transfer in the first half of this year the required advance payment of around two bilion crowns to the state budget.
- Prime Minister Vladimir Meciar said the state would extend 2.5 billion crowns in 1997 to help banks restructure their loan portfolios.
- Meciar said the OECD had critised the recent law postponing the bank privatisation until the end of next March, saying it was an obstacle for Slovakia's integration into the organisation.
- Meciar said the law on bank privatisation would result in pressure to create another, fifth, large financial institution, probably a commercial bank.
- The National Property Fund (NPF), the state privatisation agency, has approved privatisation of another 26 companies. The sale totalled some 670 million crowns.

- State-run Slovak Railways (ZRS) will invest around 40 million crowns into a railway cargo terminal in Zvolen, central Slovakia. There will be a regular direct train connection between the terminal and the Dutch port of Rotterdam.
SME - Police said the car blast which this spring killed former policeman involved in the kidnapping of president's son, was caused by an unidentified explosive.
- The independent trade unions of medical doctors (LOZ), grouping the majority of the Slovak doctors, will decide this Saturday whether doctors will strike to support their demands for a pay rise.

PRAVDA - The deputy chairwoman of the ruling Movement for a Democratic Slovakia (HZDS), Olga Keltosova, said HZDS was ready for early elections which would help solve the current problems on the Slovak political scene.
NARODNA OBRODA - The opposition Party of the Democratic Left (SDL) will become a member of the Socialist International (SI) at the SI's 20th congress, scheduled for September 9 to September 11.
